Live Presentations

State of the Art Live Presentations for Any Stage

From intimate briefings to full conference keynotes — we handle every technical detail so your presenters can focus on delivering the message, not managing the technology.

Lafayette Sound delivers seamless live presentations for groups of 20 or 2000. From podium speakers and microphones to confidence monitors, slide management, and complete run-of-show coordination, we ensure every element of your presentation runs flawlessly. Our experienced crew handles all technical details from load-in through strike, so your speakers perform at their best and your audience never notices the technology behind it.

What's Included

  • Speakers and microphones for any room size
  • Wireless handheld, lapel, and podium microphones
  • Confidence monitors and teleprompter support
  • Slide and presentation control
  • Run-of-show coordination
  • Pre-show rehearsal and sound check
  • Podium and lectern setup
  • ADA Compliance for all stage and audience setups
  • On-site technical support throughout the event
